_about: How the 1900 Materials' native forms are spelled in The Chukchee's notation, for matching a form against that text's ratified index (harness/counterpart.py; docs/multitext.md, "Counterparts in The Chukchee"). One author made both books from one set of notes, so the correspondence is expected to be regular. A spelling list is space separated; ∅ is a letter the other notation omits. A counterpart is a witness against a misreading, never a source.
_obscure: The key's obscure vowels (keying_spec §2): matched against any vowel, as a near miss only.
